svg.aria-label: Daily life: Moe's room at dusk, seen from behind his chair. Through a steel window, Teide with the town lights at its foot and the moon over the sea; a tortoiseshell cat sleeps on the sill. Four monitors on one arm show the Sasuke Lens notch, an L2 service-desk queue where a VPN ticket gets resolved, code being built with an AI assistant until it deploys, and an anime with subtitles. A small TV on the shelf shows a football match ending in a goal, a side screen has a paused game, and the desk holds a lamp, a dragon tree, a speaker playing music, the home NAS, a coffee, a game controller and the PC. A guitar stands on its floor stand.
